scenes.title: HOOK
scenes.narration: Creatine or protein. Which one actually builds *muscle*?

scenes.title: MAIN EDUCATION - PROTEIN
scenes.narration: *Protein* is the bricks. Aim for about *one point six grams* per kilogram of body weight a day.

scenes.title: MAIN EDUCATION - CREATINE
scenes.narration: *Creatine* is the fuel. Three to five grams daily can get you an extra rep or two.

scenes.title: VISUAL DEMONSTRATION
scenes.narration: Early jump on the scale? That's water, not fat.

scenes.title: KEY TAKEAWAYS
scenes.narration: So *protein* wins. Creatine can't build what you never eat. Kidney issues? Ask your doctor first.

scenes.title: ENDING
scenes.narration: Follow for more no-hype training science.
